title: An integrable top-dimensional density defines a current
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, and v : ℝ^n → ℝ Lebesgue integrable. Then there is T ∈ D_n(ℝ^n) (a GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with T(ω) = ∫ v(x) ω(x)(e_0, …, e_m) dx for every ω ∈ D^n(ℝ^n), where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), Integrable v → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), T ω = ∫ x, v x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
